nodes.label: The One Rule: This Repo Is a Universal Template
nodes.rationale: People fork and adapt to their own market, language and profile, so upstream stays market-agnostic, person-agnostic and Claude Code-native. A contribution is judged by fit to this rule first and execution quality second; well-built but off-policy still gets declined.

nodes.label: Market-Specific Skills Live in Forks
nodes.rationale: One country's portal opens the door to every country's portal and there is no principled stopping point (precedent: India #31, France #39, China #67). In-tree portals are either country-agnostic (linkedin-search) or the maintainer's own demonstration instance (the Danish portals).

nodes.label: No Alternative-Harness Ports or Duplicate Workflow Sources
nodes.rationale: The markdown specs ARE the implementation; a second copy drifts the moment either changes, and CI cannot run other harnesses so a parallel command tree ships untested. Upstream instead maintains portable .agents/skills/, the AGENTS.md pointer, and framework_version markers. Explicitly a decision, not a dogma - re-evaluated if cross-runtime standards mature.

nodes.label: The Bar for New Commands
nodes.rationale: The core lifecycle is feature-complete, so a new command must operationalize something error-prone that already exists (documented machinery nothing executes, data something writes but nothing reads). "Useful" and "possible" are insufficient; the strongest proposals connect two existing things without modifying either.

nodes.label: Claims Get Verified (reproduce on the real path)
nodes.rationale: A test that fails on master and passes on the fix is necessary but not sufficient: the failing input must be one the workflow actually produces, not a synthetic value fed straight to the function. Fixes demonstrated only on inputs the real code path never receives are declined even with green tests.

nodes.label: Portal-Skill Contract
nodes.rationale: search/detail commands, --format json|table|plain, stderr JSON errors with exit 1, backoff on 429/5xx, zero runtime dependencies by default; linkedin-search is the reference implementation.

nodes.label: Community Forks & Adaptations Discussion (#78)
nodes.rationale: Market-specific skills are valuable but live in forks where their maintainers can test them; a pinned index is how their users find them. The proven fork shape is a thin pointer that references upstream specs rather than copying them.
